claude_proposed_widenings.name: Dynamic exile-duration formula based on current occupants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ActivatedAbility duration model only supports fixed timed durations. Rod of Security ends after a number of days computed from how many creatures are present in the demiplane.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Return-on-end exile lifecycle to original activation site
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can exile creatures with transport_exile, but it cannot model the mandatory return when the effect ends or when the wielder ends it early, nor the destination back to the activation location or nearest unoccupied space.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the time runs out or you take a Magic action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Hourly healing amount derived from each visitor's Hit Point Die
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has heal_hp, but no way to express a recurring per-hour heal whose amount is computed from the target creature's own Hit Point Die progression rather than a fixed DiceAmount.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains Hit Points as if it had spent 1 Hit Point Die.
